workflows.name: Burst a GPU job, then serve cheaper tokens
steps: Put the training, batch image, or video job on a GPU cloud such as Modal, RunPod, Lambda, Lightning, or Vast.ai and set a runtime cap before it starts.
Write the weights or outputs to durable storage before the machine stops so the next step does not depend on that instance.
Serve the interactive text or small-model calls from an inference API such as Groq, Cerebras, OpenRouter, Workers AI, or Google AI Studio.
Run the same short prompt set on two providers, compare latency and cost, and keep the provider, model id, and sample response with the workflow.

workflows.name: Prototype in a free inference console
steps: Draft the prompt in Google AI Studio, Groq, Cerebras, or NVIDIA NIM and write down the model id that produced the useful answer.
If the free quota is too small, send the same request shape to OpenRouter, Hugging Face Inference, Fireworks, Together, fal, Replicate, or DeepInfra.
Record the provider, model id, a sample response, and what the call costs before leaving the prototype on that route.
